name: Megumi Pharmacy
description: Megumi Pharmacy — a WooCommerce-compatible block theme for an independent community pharmacy. A full-bleed film-grain photograph of the counter is the stage for the hero and the introduction while the white page slides up over it; three 0.77 portrait link cards with the label inside the photograph; a hairline list of six people beside a 3:4 portrait; numbered rows 01-05 on a pale inset panel beside a 3:4 photograph whose neighbour peeks at the window edge. White ground, warm-grey ink, one muted dusty-rose accent (#8A7070). Literata and Public Sans. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: display: headings, card labels, row titles, the wordmark (variable 400-600 and italic; Latin subset)
text: body, navigation, kickers, prices (variable 400-700, Latin subset)
